name: Yout
description: Yout was a planet located in the Qiilura sector of the Mid Rim. It had at least twelve moons, including one known as Yout 12, where the assassin droid KRONOS-327 was sent to assassinate a Black Sun Vigo, a task which KRONOS-327 failed.
lead_paragraphs: Yout was a planet located in the Qiilura sector of the Mid Rim. It had at least twelve moons, including one known as Yout 12, where the assassin droid KRONOS-327 was sent to assassinate a Black Sun Vigo, a task which KRONOS-327 failed.
